query:
SELECT CONCAT(state_code, '-', district) as race, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, ROUND(candidate1_vote_pct,1) as c1pct,
       candidate2_name, candidate2_party, ROUND(candidate2_vote_pct,1) as c2pct,
       pct_reporting, primary_winner, primary_party, status
FROM house_races WHERE state_code IN ('NE','WV','OH') AND (primary_winner IS NOT NULL OR pct_reporting > 0)
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT(state_code, ' Senate') as race, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, ROUND(candidate1_vote_pct,1) as c1pct,
       candidate2_name, candidate2_party, ROUND(candidate2_vote_pct,1) as c2pct,
       pct_reporting, primary_winner, primary_party, status
FROM senate_races WHERE state_code IN ('NE','WV','OH')
ORDER BY race LIMIT 20;
